text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-82719 -> gpu-node-az3-45 reported KERNEL_PANIC and kubelet NotReady. Auto-escalation to eng-oncall.

pagerduty: Escalation: Page sent to Oncall Alice (primary).

Oncall Alice: acked the page -- looking. 

Oncall Alice: quick check: `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-az3-45 -o wide` shows NotReady. pinging node.

Infra Ben: I'll try to reach host via IP 10.32.45.77, ssh attempt now.

SRE Carla: noted customer-facing clusters using this rack: rdw-prod-1 has 3 pods pinned to GPU pool; loadbalancer should have fallback to rdw-prod-2. I'll verify routing.

Infra Ben: ssh failed: connection timed out. Console access shows repeated "Kernel panic - not syncing" messages in serial log. Suspect hardware fault.

Oncall Alice: thanks. Marking node as unschedulable to prevent new pods: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-az3-45
kubectl drain gpu-node-az3-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

SRE Carla: drain progressing; two pods evicted, one stuck (restarting-loop). I'm forcing delete and letting deployment recreate elsewhere.

Platform Raj: checking platform autoscaler — there is capacity in az1 and az2. Routing should failover but I'm verifying there are no affinity constraints blocking reschedule.

Customer Success Maya: any customer impact yet? I got a DM from a customer in EU complaining about timeouts for batch encoding jobs. Could be related.

Oncall Alice: probable partial impact for workloads pinned to that GPU pool. Not a global outage. Setting incident severity: SEV-2 (partial degradation).

pagerduty: Oncall Alice acknowledged the page at 1976543215.

Infra Ben: console screenshot attached in thread (serial logs). Kernel OOPS shows: 
```
[ 1234.567890] Kernel panic - not syncing: fatal exception
[ 1234.567897] CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted
[ 1234.567902] Call Trace:
[ 1234.567905]  <TASK> ...
```

Oncall Alice: since kernel panic, node will not recover remotely. Plan: mark node unschedulable (done), drain (done where possible), create support ticket with infra for NIC/PSU/MBR checks and schedule a reboot cycle with hardware team.

SRE Carla: I've updated routing rules to prefer other AZs for new sessions and increased replica count on critical deployments by +1 temporarily to compensate. Observability: request latency for model-generation endpoints increased 8-12% in impacted region.

Platform Raj: confirming autoscaler added one replacement GPU node in az2 at 1976543240; kubelet joined and pods are shifting.

Oncall Alice: good. Starting live mitigation notes: 
- cordon + drain (completed)
- temporary replica bump (carla)
- autoscaler replacement (raj)
- customer comms (maya)

Customer Success Maya: I'm sending an advisory to affected customers: short note that we've identified a compute host kernel panic, workloads are failing over, and we expect full recovery in ~15-30m. Will follow up if impact persists. :email:

Infra Ben: opened ticket TICK-2149 with datacenter ops for RMA if node doesn't come back. Also scheduled a scheduled maintenance window to physically reboot and run memtest.

Oncall Alice: checking logs for kubelet errors while joining: 
```
journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 | tail -n 50
-- Logs begin at ... --
Oct  3 02:04:12 kubelet[1234]: E1003 02:04:12.123] failed to register node: post /api/v1/nodes: dial tcp ...: connection refused
```

SRE Carla: note: one critical job failed to reschedule due to node affinity on label `gpu-type: a100-v2`. I patched deployment to allow `a100-v1` as fallback and restarted rollout. Monitoring for quality regression.

Oncall Alice: adding runbook actions for post-incident: collect dmesg, serial logs, dump of `kubectl describe node`, list of affected pods, route changes, customer pings.

pagerduty: Escalation: If not acknowledged in 5m will notify secondary (Infra Ben). (automated)

Oncall Alice: I will handoff in 20m to Infra Ben for hardware follow-up. Leaving context in ops doc: link to internal runbook (https://wiki.internal/incident/PD-82719).

Infra Ben: taking over at 1976543247. I'll coordinate with datacenter ops and escalate to vendor if RMA needed.

SRE Carla: summary for postmortem: cause = host kernel panic (likely hardware). Impact = partial regional degradation for GPU workloads pinned to that rack; mitigation = cordon/drain, autoscaler replacement, affinity fallbacks. Actions = RMA or repair, revisit affinity policies and auto-fallback rules, add healthcheck route to avoid scheduling to hosts showing kernel oops.

Customer Success Maya: emailed affected customers at 1976543255. Two customers acknowledged and thanked for quick update.

Oncall Alice: marking this thread as incident active. Will update when node is physically recovered or RMA confirmed.

Infra Ben: datacenter ops will attempt powercycle now; ETA 25m.

Oncall Alice: thanks all. Follow-ups: assign postmortem owner (SRE Carla) and schedule blameless postmortem within 72 hours.

SRE Carla: assigned. I'll draft timeline and impact metrics.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-82719 status changed to "acknowledged" by Oncall Alice.

Oncall Alice: closing live mitigation loop for now — handoff complete. If the node comes back unexpectedly, do not uncordon until infra verifies. :thumbsup:

Infra Ben: update at 1976543267: datacenter ops reports powercycle failed, node remains unresponsive. RMA path initiated. Will update ticket with serial number and vendor contact.

Oncall Alice: noted. Changing incident status to monitoring. Postmortem owner Carla; infra to follow RMA.

-- end of thread --
